=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:1-102 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The helper does not enforce its declared credential trust boundary: it can leave credentials exposed or restore them to unverified destinations while reporting success.
  WHY: The reviewers cite failures in repository identity, push URL, extraheader, and exit-status validation that let the network-capable editor retain or gain access to workflow credentials.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:102 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The unconditional `exit 0` discards restore validation failures and reports success to callers.
  WHY: Callers cannot detect rejected or incomplete restores and may continue with credentials hidden or injected into an unverified origin.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:76-83 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Restore accepts any `https://github.com/` origin without verifying that its repository path matches the workflow repository or trusted support checkout.
  WHY: An editor-changed GitHub destination can receive `GH_TOKEN`.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:35-53 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Hide does not inspect `remote.origin.pushurl` or `pushInsteadOf` rewrites before the editor runs.
  WHY: A credentialed or redirected push destination can remain usable by the network-capable editor.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:76-84 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: Restore does not validate that the editor left the push URL in agreement with the verified origin.
  WHY: An editor-changed push URL can direct authenticated pushes to an unverified destination.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:35-53 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Hide records extraheader configuration keys verbatim without rejecting keys whose URL contains embedded credentials.
  WHY: A credential-bearing key is written to the editor-readable marker file, exposing the embedded credential.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:19-28 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Hide does not require and validate `GITHUB_REPOSITORY` before operating on checkout configurations.
  WHY: Without a trusted repository identity, hide cannot verify that it is operating on the expected workflow checkout.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:29-33 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The repository check uses `git -C` in a way that walks up from a non-checkout subdirectory and finds a parent repository.
  WHY: Hide can modify the parent repository's origin instead of skipping the supplied non-checkout directory.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:85-93 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Restore can reinstate a generic GitHub extraheader without scoping it to the verified origin repository.
  WHY: The authorization header can apply to requests for repositories beyond the verified checkout.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:61-97 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: Restore injects credentials into earlier checkouts before validating all checkouts and configuration entries.
  WHY: A later validation failure leaves credentials already injected into a checkout despite the overall restore being invalid.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:21-23 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Hide exits successfully when an unrestored marker already exists.
  WHY: A stale marker indicates the previous hide-and-restore cycle did not complete, but callers are allowed to proceed without a confirmed credential state. Severity disagreement: some reviewers classified this as major; the highest reported severity is critical.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:25-28 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Hide exits successfully when marker creation fails.
  WHY: The editor can launch without the helper having confirmed that credentials were hidden.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:56-60 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Restore with no marker exits silently without the expected `reason=marker_missing` diagnostic.
  WHY: Callers cannot distinguish a missing marker from a successful restore. Severity disagreement: some reviewers classified this as major; the highest reported severity is critical.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:57-59 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Restore exits successfully when `GH_TOKEN` is missing, leaving credentials hidden.
  WHY: Callers cannot detect the failed restoration and may proceed to push without authentication. Severity disagreement: some reviewers classified this as major; the highest reported severity is critical.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:78-84 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Restore does not reject credentials re-added to the origin by the editor before injecting `GH_TOKEN`.
  WHY: An editor-modified credential-bearing origin passes the host check and receives the workflow token.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:85-92 | severity=critical | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Restore leaves a generic GitHub extraheader at broad scope instead of creating the expected repository-scoped header without a `.git` suffix.
  WHY: The restored header remains applicable beyond the verified repository. Severity disagreement: some reviewers classified the related scoping issue as major; the highest reported severity is critical.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "The credential helper rejects failed hides/restores and restores auth only when the origin still names the workflow's original repository (or its trusted support checkout) and its push URL agrees, not an editor-changed GitHub destination; generic GitHub extraheaders are restored scoped to the verified origin only."
  expected_change_site: scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: `scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh` hide branch does not require trusted repository identity, inspect push URLs or pushInsteadOf rewrites, or reject credential-bearing extraheader keys; restore branch does not verify repository identity or push URL agreement, does not scope restored extraheaders to the verified origin, and returns success on failure paths; reviewers report 18 failures in `tests/test_heal_evidence_editor_isolation.py` in CI run 37311550103.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
